_contract: K3 preview-truth (2026-07-19). ONE semantic JSON per flat style; two projections are derived from it: the DISPLAY projection (engine/flat-engine styles.json recipe of the same key) and the DRAFT projection (the C++ pattern engine via draftJSON). engine/tools/preview-truth.mjs diffs the two: STRUCTURAL EQUALITY is the hard rule (every structural element drawn in the flat must have a counterpart among the drafted pieces, and every drafted piece must be represented in the flat — undeclared gaps FAIL); LANDMARK DEVIATION is the soft rule (threshold 8%; a deviation above threshold must cite a contract-declared stylisation below and stays PINNED — drift beyond a pin FAILS the deploy chain).
